system.description:
The rarest divination: lays bare the past and future of organizations, cities and nations (never an individual's future). Can grant Prophetic Alignment to those who share the vision.

Ritual. Alignment: Formidable (12) Knowledge, 1 hour. Invocation: Challenging (9) Awareness, 5 hours; harder for distant or obscure subjects. Unleashing: Formidable (12) Will. The player asks the Narrator questions about the fate of a group, city or nation.

Art of Divination — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 99.
system.resonances: The Method's resonances plus ritual ingredients (3 gold pieces).

ritual.invocation: Challenging (9) Awareness, 5 hours; harder for distant or obscure subjects.
ritual.unleashing: Formidable (12) Will. The player asks the Narrator questions about the fate of a group, city or nation.
